title: Middle Eastern Harees with Peanut Butter Sauce
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish made with slow-cooked wheat and meat, served with a creamy peanut butter sauce.
instructions: Soak the harees in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the harees, then place it in a saucepan with 2 cups of water.
Add the chopped onion and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the harees is tender.
Meanwhile, blend the peanut butter with a little water until smooth.
Add the peanut butter sauce to the harees and stir well.
Serve hot, garnished with crispy bread crumbs.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
